// CUSTODY LAYER · UNIVERSAL SAFE offline · air-gapped · sovereign离线 · 断网 · 主权

The safe that 这只保险箱 never talks to the network从不与网络交谈

Vault is the universal offline safe for Engine-class apps. It stores private keys and login signatures with zero internet permission, seals them inside the phone's secure silicon, signs with your fingerprint, and moves keys to new hardware through light alone — a QR code. Not "we promise not to connect." It cannot connect. Vault 是 Engine 这类应用的通用离线保险箱。它以零联网权限保管私钥与登录签名，把密钥封进手机的安全芯片，用指纹完成签名，并仅凭一道光 —— 二维码 —— 将私钥迁移到新硬件。不是"我们承诺不联网"，而是它在物理上就无法联网。

02 / MANDATE WHAT IT GUARDS守护什么

One job: be the一件事：做所有主权应用的 safe of every sovereign app保险箱

Vault is app-agnostic by design. Anything shaped like Engine — an app that wants online life with offline keys — can delegate its identity to the safe. Vault 在设计上与应用无关。任何长得像 Engine 的应用 —— 想要"在线生活、离线密钥"的应用 —— 都可以把身份托付给保险箱。

🗝️
App private keys应用私钥ECDSA P-256 identities generated by apps like Engine, sealed the moment they arrive.Engine 这类应用生成的 ECDSA P-256 身份，到达即封存。
🖋️
Login & wallet signatures登录与钱包签名Challenge-response login codes and SPARK wallet transactions — signed inside the safe, never stored online. Every balance change is a signed transaction on an append-only chain.挑战应答登录码与 SPARK 钱包交易 —— 在保险箱内签名，从不在线存储。每一笔余额变动都是追加式签名链上的一笔交易。
⟳
Device migration bindings换机迁移绑定Signed re-bind records that move your identity to fresh hardware without a cloud backup.带签名的重绑记录，无需云备份即可把身份迁到新硬件。
🧿
Fingerprint directory指纹目录A local registry of every guarded key, its fingerprint and seal state — visible at a glance.本地登记每一把受守护的密钥、其指纹与封存状态 —— 一目了然。
🚫
Nothing else别无其他No browsing, no sync, no ads, no telemetry. A safe with a screen, not a smartphone app.不浏览、不同步、无广告、无遥测。是一台带屏幕的保险箱，不是手机应用。
🔓
Biometric-only unlock仅生物识别解锁Every unseal passes BiometricPrompt with a ±120s freshness window — clock-based replay protection.每次解封都要过生物识别，并校验 ±120 秒时效窗口 —— 按时钟防重放。
03 / CEREMONY HOW AN ONLINE APP SIGNS OFFLINE在线应用如何离线签名

The key signs.密钥签名， The key never leaves.密钥不离箱。

Engine needs a signatureEngine 需要签名 → IPC request + challengeIPC 请求 + 挑战值 → BiometricPrompt生物识别 → TEE unseals & signsTEE 解封并签名 → signed callback带签名回调 → Engine verifies sig + Δt<120sEngine 验签 + Δt<120s
WHY THE ±120s WINDOW MATTERS为什么 ±120 秒窗口很重要 The callback signature covers sessionId ‖ status ‖ timestamp. Even a stolen callback cannot be replayed minutes later — the clock is part of the proof. The relay never sees the key; Engine never holds the key; only the TEE ever does. 回调签名覆盖 sessionId ‖ status ‖ timestamp。即便回调被窃取，也无法在几分钟后重放 —— 时间本身就是证明的一部分。中继看不见密钥，Engine 不持有密钥，只有 TEE 始终持有。
04 / MIGRATION NEW PHONE, SAME IDENTITY新手机，同一身份

Moving house through搬家只经过 a beam of light一道光

Private keys are the one thing you must never trust to a cloud. When your hardware changes, Vault walks your identity across devices screen-to-screen — step through it below. 私钥是唯一绝不能托付给云端的东西。换硬件时，Vault 让你的身份在两块屏幕之间徒步迁徙 —— 下面逐步走一遍。

🖤
FLAG_SECUREFLAG_SECUREThe QR screen blacks out screenshots and screen recordings. Shoulder-surfing is the only attack left.二维码页面在截图与录屏时一律黑屏；仅剩的攻击手段只有肩窥偷看。
Encrypted payload加密载荷The bind URI carries an encrypted session payload — the raw private key never appears in any URI.绑定 URI 只携带加密会话载荷 —— 裸私钥从不出现在任何 URI 里。
Burn after binding绑定即烧毁Engine calls convertBoundToPublicKeyOnly() — its private-key copy is wiped the moment Vault takes over.Engine 调用 convertBoundToPublicKeyOnly() —— Vault 接管的瞬间，其私钥副本即被擦除。

Vault's isolation is declared in the Android manifest and enforced by the OS — a packet cannot be sent, so a promise is never needed. 表中其余每一行都指望"有人守规矩"。Vault 的隔离写进 Android 清单、由操作系统强制执行 —— 数据包发不出去，所以从不需要承诺。
